content.value: A company manufacture two types of products X and Y. The raw materials required for one unit of product X is 10kg and for Y is 8 kg. The machine hour required for each product of X is 5 hours and for Y is 7 hours. The total amount of raw materials and machine hours available are 400kg and 240 hours respectively. The demand for product X is almost 30 units. The profit for product X and Y are Tk 800 and Tk 600 respectively. Formulate this problem as mathematical model to maximize profit.

_source_title: B.Sc. Engineering 4th Year 1st Term Regular Examination, 2018
